upcoming_events.title: Destin Seafood Festival
upcoming_events.description: Three days along the harbor boardwalk: Friday Sept 25 (4–10 PM), Saturday Sept 26 (10 AM–10 PM, closing under fireworks), and Sunday Sept 27 (10 AM–6 PM). Free to attend, with more than 75 food, art and retail vendors, five music stages, and a Kids Zone — Gulf shrimp, crab and grouper straight off the boats. Come early for parking and make a day of the harbor · about a 35-min drive west.

upcoming_events.title: Cars of 30A
upcoming_events.description: Friday's Torque to Table brings a sunset cocktail hour and open-air dinner alongside a preview of the collection (5–8 PM, 21+); Saturday's Grand Tour, 1–4 PM, spreads more than 150 rare and high-performance cars through the north side of Alys Beach and around Lake Marilyn, with live music, art and food · 10-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Harvest Wine & Food Festival
upcoming_events.description: 10th annual · four days in WaterColor — Celebrity Winemaker Dinners Thursday, Harvest After Dark Friday, the Grand Tasting Saturday Oct 17 in Cerulean Park (1–4 PM), and a Festival Brunch Sunday · benefits DCWAF children's charities · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Beer Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · Friday night (6–8 PM) brings football on the big screen, bourbon, and bonfires under the stars; Saturday is the Grand Craft Beer Tasting with Seltzer Lane and food pairings · $55 pre-sale, $65 at the gate · 25-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Halloweener Derby & Oktoberfest
upcoming_events.description: 16th annual · Saturday Oct 24, 10 AM–2 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater · dachshund races down Central Square and an all-breeds costume contest, with Oktoberfest food and drink alongside · free to watch, bring the dog and a camera · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seeing Red Wine Festival
upcoming_events.description: 34 years running · a vintners dinner at Bud & Alley's, the Al Fresco Reserve Tasting, Battle of the Somms, the Grand Tasting in Central Square, and a Celebration of Bubbles brunch · benefits DCWAF · tickets on sale now · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Rosemary Beach Uncorked
upcoming_events.description: 15th annual · Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 1–4 PM on Barrett Square · wines poured by vintners from around the world alongside dishes from Rosemary Beach restaurants, with live music as you stroll the cobblestone streets · sold out — join the waitlist at rosemarybeachuncorked.com · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Central Square Cinema
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 30 · Fri 8 PM · Free family movies on the big screen at the Seaside Amphitheater, Fridays at 8 PM — Scoob! (Sept 25), Air Bud (Oct 2), Hoppers (Oct 9), Hotel Transylvania (Oct 16), Coco (Oct 23), and a Halloween feature (Oct 30) · bring a blanket and the kids · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Morning Vinyasa Yoga
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 31 · Daily 8:30 AM · Every morning at 8:30 AM on the pavilion overlooking the Gulf, weather permitting · no preregistration, $25 drop-in by cash, check, or Venmo · bring a mat or towel and water · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round · 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

copy.instagram:
Gulf shrimp, crab and grouper straight off the boats — the Destin Seafood Festival runs through Sunday on the harbor boardwalk, about 35 minutes west.

Saturday goes 10 AM to 10 PM and closes under fireworks.

Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Mon 28, three nights, with three king bedrooms and the quiet back patio waiting when you get home.

Book direct — link in bio.
copy.facebook: The Destin Seafood Festival is on through Sunday along the harbor boardwalk — 75+ vendors, five music stages, and Saturday closing under fireworks, about a 35-minute drive west of us. Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Mon 28 (3 nights): three king bedrooms, a fireplace, and a private back patio for the slow part of the evening. Live dates and real prices at https://book.sunandmoon30a.com
